decisions.reason: As a publicly presented flagship range with several models central to the firm's announced direction, Product A carries high sunk costs and visible commitment, making escalation of commitment strongly favor keeping it.

Although Product B is a single close-to-established shoe with less public commitment, the firm has invested in it and there is no clear evidence of failure, so escalation of commitment still favors keeping it but less strongly than the flagship.

As a multi-model safety shoe series close to the established offer, Product C represents substantial invested resources and a visible product line, which under escalation of commitment makes the firm likely to persist.
